text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Ikuno Dictus looking around the
track by
herself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If the starting gate is here, and the
audience will
be over there... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've been tasked with organizing the
scrimmage for this year's orientation, so
I'm doing some
preliminary inspections
for it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, but could you please move
from that
area? I need to measure the
track's width.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I assume that is why I was entrusted
with this
duty.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Orientations are not the time to cut any
corners.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I still have much to do, so if you'll
excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I alone was given this task. Once I
have a lay
of the situation, the rest of
my work should be
easy.
choice_data_list: Are you doing all of that on your own?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her confident claim, it still
seems like a
lot of work for one person.
I'm about to offer to
help, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, Ikuno! Are you seriously
trying to
do everything by yourself
again?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Didn't we tell you to let us know if you
needed
help?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But I'm the one who was entrusted with this—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. But three heads are better
than one,
and we'll finish quicker too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then can you two start taking
these
flags and...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies. I have to instruct
them on
what to do, so I must take my
leave.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to get a good idea of the
audience's view from the bleachers, so
please stand in the front and back
corners and wave your flags. After
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus seems to be very well-liked
by her
friends. It appears my services
aren't needed after
all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. There's never a reason
not to be.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The general public will also be present
during the
orientation.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And in the audience will surely be
Umamusume
who will one day be among
our members.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I want those future Tracen students to
have a
relaxing and enjoyable
experience here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: But that is not the only reason.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If we consider that this orientation is a
local event meant for the whole
community to enjoy, it's
imperative to
design it to be accessible to all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I learn a lot about how much goes into
making such an event fun... as well as
how passionate
Ikuno Dictus is about
this orientation.
